name: Negative / Constellation
look: Light lines on a near-black void; figures as constellations; one warm accent; plate B is the inverted frame

axes.base: near-black void with a soft radial lift and dark corners, dust motes
axes.line: light contours, nested toward the core, 12 fps boil; exact curves for forces
axes.tone: no hatching or fills; tone from nested contours; glow on accent and nodes only
axes.planB: the negative: the same frame under grade { invert: 1 }
axes.motion: weightless 24 fps glide, loops per shot, 2-frame blinks on an uneven schedule
axes.accent: one warm accent on one thing only
axes.match: figures persist across cuts; void-to-negative match cuts keep every pixel
axes.overlays: one instrument overlay per shot: rings, ticks, brackets, rules
